title: World Bloom — Link the Beats! — Episode12 So Much Fun!

meta.Event Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_ppr_op6
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Mumble*
Hona... Your apple pies are so yummy...

rows.Speaker: Chick Plushie
rows.Line: Rin just said something!

rows.Speaker: Bear Plushie
rows.Line: Apple pies? Is she talking about food?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mhm... I'm so full...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha...
This is a bit of a weird situation.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I finally found where this me went, but what do I do now? Her KAITO vanished with her, but is he somewhere in this SEKAI too?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (The plushies are there with her, but she's still probably gonna feel kinda scared when she...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Groan*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, she's awake! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm...? W-Wait a second!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wh-What happened?! Huh?!
I was watering the tree a second ago...! Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What's going on here?!
Where am I?! What is this place?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Anyone would be startled after waking up somewhere completely new and unfamiliar.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: L-Look how big this stage is...!

rows.Speaker: Chick Plushie
rows.Line: Oh, you're awake!

rows.Speaker: Bear Plushie
rows.Line: Morning, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: T-Talking plushies...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Woooow!
This place is awesome!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
So, how is it that you guys can talk?!
You gotta tell me!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I thought she'd be scared or at least surprised...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But she seems perfectly fine here.

rows.Speaker: Bear Plushie
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
We need to tell the troupe leader that you're awake!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? The troupe leader?

rows.Speaker: Chick Plushie
rows.Line:
Yeah, he's our leader!
Our troupe has lots of members 'cause we do lots of shows, and...
Huh? Is someone there?
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rin & Rin
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's another Rin?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Why's there another me?!
Am I dreaming?!

rows.Speaker: Chick Plushie
rows.Line: It's not a dream!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Chick Plushie
rows.Line: Um, KAITO and the others told us all about it! They said this Rin probably came from another SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whaat?! So, this is a different SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! This is what me from another SEKAI looks like?!
Um, hi☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe. Hi!
This feels so strange...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know, right?! But it's also kinda fun♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, how did you get to this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I was sitting by this tree in my SEKAI, then something flashed and I was here when I woke up!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, really...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, then... Could the same thing have happened to MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did something happen to her?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Nod*
She said she was gonna water our tree, and then she disappeared.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, just maybe...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She was sent over to another SEKAI just like me...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Uuuuugh!
No fair! No fair! I wanna visit another SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I also wanted to meet the MEIKO from this one!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... But I managed to get here, so I might be able to meet her in the future♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right☆ And I should totally be able to visit another SEKAI someday too!
Hey, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounded like Len!
Lemme introduce you to him, Rin☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Cool, thanks!
I can't wait to see what the Len from this SEKAI is like.
se_walk_men_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
H-Huh...?
Two Rins...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hiya☆
So, the thing is, I came over from a different SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I still don't really know what exactly happened, but I hope we can all be friends♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin from another SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... MEIKO's gone too, so does that mean I'm still dreaming...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
This isn't a dream, Luka!
If you pinch your cheeks, it'll hurt, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You never change, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, anyway! We were just talking about how MEIKO was probably sent to a different SEKAI like Rin here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is that what happened...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, I won't be able to use her lap as a pillow for a while...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Use her lap as a pillow?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Whenever Luka takes a nap, she likes to use MEIKO's lap as a pillow♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Luka napping on MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Phew...
I'm feeling a little tired after practicing so much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hey, MEIKO? Can we take a quick break?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure. Would you like for me to do our usual thing?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, that'd be lovely.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Luka, you're so coddled.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I-Is that what they're doing when I'm not around?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha!
Seeing the Luka from her SEKAI do that would make me laugh so hard.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: On the other hand, it'd be pretty surprising if you didn't know about the Luka from this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, also, where are Miku-P and KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They were looking for MEIKO just like us, but...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! Then, does that mean I can meet them?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Definitely☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
We should give this Rin a tour of our SEKAI♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We're bound to run into Miku and the others somewhere along the way!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Of course.
So, let's... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh?! L-Luka?! Is she okay?!
She fell asleep standing up...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪ She always does this, so don't worry!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! Then, okay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There isn't much we can do, so we'll just have to lead her around as she sleeps.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yup! Anyway, you guys☆
Let's get going!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, an amusement park!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No fair! No fair!
I didn't know this kind of SEKAI existed!
You guys get to have fun here every day!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Come to think of it, this is the first time school SEKAI me is seeing an amusement park, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
She loves to have fun...
So, I'm sure she's really gonna enjoy herself!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, that Ferris wheel's huge!
I wanna go on it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, we can also look for Miku and the others from up there!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Good idea.
I should be able to take a nice, long nap...♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, quit taking so many naps!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, these flowers are singing!
This SEKAI's so strange... You've got talking plushies and singing flowers...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You think so? Does that mean there are SEKAI where flowers don't sing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: To be fair, the flowers where Tsukasa and the others live don't sing either.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right! Then, Rin, your SEKAI might be more similar to where they're from!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehehe♪
Wow, this is so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I had no idea roller coasters were so fast!
It made my heart jump a few times.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But it's tons of fun to zoom around on it☆
Just like with MEIKO's high fly!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: High fly? What's that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
So, it's when MEIKO grabs you and flings you really high into the sky☆
We should have her do it on us if we find her♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: O-Okay...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(She flings you high into the sky...?
Is this SEKAI's MEIKO that strong...?!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Anyway, what do you wanna go on next?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... I can't decide...
There are so many that I wanna ride...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Both versions of me look like they're having fun♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, an amusement park...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Actually, I haven't really had much of a chance to enjoy this SEKAI's amusement park.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whee!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Riding a merry-go-round in the sky is so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Since I'm here, maybe just for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, it feels a little strange to go on this while looking down at the park.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I feel like I'm going for a walk in the sky...
This feels so nice!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks for the tour, you guys!
I've absolutely, positively, totally fallen in love with this SEKAI☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Seeing you smile makes me really happy too, Rin☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad for the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks!
Oh, you guys...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, that voice...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It's Emu!
She's Tsukasa's friend☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, he's the owner of the feelings that made this SEKAI♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's go!
I'll introduce you to her, Rin☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Hehe. I can't wait to see what she's like...!)
